name: Chrome CDP
description: Real Google Chrome for the agent: launches a visible Chrome window and drives it over the DevTools Protocol (navigate, snapshot, click, fill, screenshots, JavaScript, console, tabs, raw CDP).

agentTools.name: Chrome
agentTools.description: Drive a real Google Chrome window over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). Call ToolSearch for "chrome", "cdp" or "browser automation" to load this tool. Action launch starts Chrome (visible window) and connects; every other action uses that window, including when the user works in another app. Then snapshot the accessibility tree, click/fill by uid (e1, e2, …), take screenshots, evaluate JavaScript, read console output, manage tabs, or send a raw CDP method. Navigate first after launch; re-snapshot after a page change because uids expire. This is a real browser with cookies, localStorage and network access: treat it as the user's machine.

action.description: launch=start the browser; navigate/open a page; snapshot read the UI tree; click/fill use snapshot uids; screenshot returns the image; evaluate runs JavaScript in the page; console reads console output; tabs/select/close manage tabs; cdp sends a raw CDP method; status reports state.

url.description: http(s) URL for action=launch and action=navigate.

uid.description: Snapshot uid (e1, e2, …) for action=click and action=fill.

method.description: CDP method for action=cdp, e.g. Page.getLayoutMetrics.

fullPage.description: Capture beyond the viewport for action=screenshot.

targetId.description: Tab target id for action=select and action=close.

index.description: Tab index from action=tabs for action=select.

closeWindow.description: Also close the browser window for action=close (default true).

settings.title: Chrome binary path
settings.description: Absolute path to chrome.exe / Google Chrome. Empty = autodetect the standard install locations.

settings.title: Profile directory
settings.description: Chrome --user-data-dir. Empty = ~/.pi-desktop/chrome-cdp-profile (a private profile, safe to delete).

settings.title: DevTools port
settings.description: localhost port for --remote-debugging-port. If Chrome already answers there, the plugin attaches instead of launching.

settings.title: Attach to running Chrome
settings.description: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9222 to drive a Chrome you started yourself with --remote-debugging-port. Empty = launch our own.

settings.title: Headless
settings.description: Start Chrome without a visible window (--headless=new).

settings.title: Extra Chrome arguments
settings.description: Whitespace-separated extra flags appended to the Chrome command line.
